patches_modified.name: All-In-One
patches_modified.description: Enables video playback and downloads, removes ads and upsell prompts, bypasses the region block, and unlocks the hidden Laboratory menu. Requires Android 10 or later.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium servers and removes ads, upgrade banners, the launch paywall and the Android TV sign-in screen.

patches_added.name: Hide layout components
patches_added.description: Adds settings to hide the Help center, Spread the word and About sections.

patches_added.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_added.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_added.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read button
patches_added.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_removed.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over or keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. Another gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, open LIVE panels dark in dark mode, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA; turn it off if you don't use an HTTPS-filtering proxy.

patches_modified.name: Skip ads
patches_modified.description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by emptying the LuraPlayer ad-break schedule — both the client-side VMAP breaks (third-party ads) and the first-party house / cross-promo breaks — so no ad-periods are inserted into the timeline, and by preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.
patches_modified.previous_description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by stopping the LuraPlayer linear ad-break scheduler (client-side VAST) and preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.

patches_added.description: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.

patches_removed.name: X MLKit Vision Slimmer
